_comment: FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B-FullAttn v1 shape menu (deepinfra). FOUR 5s shapes: 720p-class landscape 1280x704 + portrait 704x1280 (the distill's native shape + transpose) and 480p landscape 832x480 + portrait 480x832 (off the distillation distribution -- quality gated on Johan's eyeball of the bake-session probe clips; drop back to the 2-shape 720p menu if 480p fails). All @ 121 frames / 24 fps, 3 denoise steps, guidance 1.0 (no CFG). Text-to-video ONLY (base TI2V-5B I2V has acknowledged quality issues; distill documents no I2V path). Dims are multiples of 32 (Wan2.2 high-compression VAE stride); 121 = 4*30+1 (temporal stride 4k+1). Serving pool: VIDEO_POOL_MODE=1 VIDEO_POOL_MAX_SIZE=4, one boot-warm shape-pinned subprocess each (~28-31GB measured/shape => ~115GB of a 180GB B200; bake validates the real peak). Adding/removing shapes changes IMAGE_SHAPE_HASH and requires a new image tag + a matching per-model menu in backend ttv.py (CI-checked).
